-- SQL sinh từ khai báo state machine; không sửa tay (DR-01, DEC-57).
-- Machine (số cặp): entry (3), sample_note (6), sample_task (7).
DELETE FROM app.state_transition
WHERE machine IN ('entry', 'sample_note', 'sample_task')
  AND (machine, from_state, to_state) NOT IN (VALUES
    ('entry', 'draft', 'final'),
    ('entry', 'draft', 'retracted'),
    ('entry', 'final', 'retracted'),
    ('sample_note', 'Nháp', 'Đã duyệt'),
    ('sample_note', 'Researcher''s Draft', 'Nháp'),
    ('sample_note', 'Đã duyệt', 'Ｚ cuối'),
    ('sample_note', 'Đã duyệt', '𝐀 đầu'),
    ('sample_note', 'Ｚ cuối', 'Lưu\trữ'),
    ('sample_note', '𝐀 đầu', 'Researcher''s Draft'),
    ('sample_task', 'Completed', 'Ready'),
    ('sample_task', 'Draft', 'Ready'),
    ('sample_task', 'In Progress', 'Completed'),
    ('sample_task', 'In Progress', 'Waiting for User'),
    ('sample_task', 'Ready', 'Cancelled'),
    ('sample_task', 'Ready', 'In Progress'),
    ('sample_task', 'Waiting for User', 'In Progress'));
--> statement-breakpoint
INSERT INTO app.state_transition (machine, from_state, to_state, code) VALUES
  ('entry', 'draft', 'final', NULL),
  ('entry', 'draft', 'retracted', NULL),
  ('entry', 'final', 'retracted', NULL),
  ('sample_note', 'Nháp', 'Đã duyệt', 'APR-01'),
  ('sample_note', 'Researcher''s Draft', 'Nháp', NULL),
  ('sample_note', 'Đã duyệt', 'Ｚ cuối', 'N''02'),
  ('sample_note', 'Đã duyệt', '𝐀 đầu', NULL),
  ('sample_note', 'Ｚ cuối', 'Lưu\trữ', NULL),
  ('sample_note', '𝐀 đầu', 'Researcher''s Draft', NULL),
  ('sample_task', 'Completed', 'Ready', NULL),
  ('sample_task', 'Draft', 'Ready', 'T-02'),
  ('sample_task', 'In Progress', 'Completed', NULL),
  ('sample_task', 'In Progress', 'Waiting for User', 'T-08'),
  ('sample_task', 'Ready', 'Cancelled', 'T-18'),
  ('sample_task', 'Ready', 'In Progress', 'T-06'),
  ('sample_task', 'Waiting for User', 'In Progress', 'T-09')
ON CONFLICT (machine, from_state, to_state) DO UPDATE SET code = EXCLUDED.code
  WHERE app.state_transition.code IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.code;
